map.17 位映射为数字（字母按表转换）后乘 8、7、6、5、4、3、2、10、0、9: Map the 17 characters to numbers (letters by table), multiply by 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 10, 0, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2; the sum mod 11 must equal the 9th position.
